anti_analysis: PEB.BeingDebugged check: anti_debug_check() (0x14000163f) reads PEB via gs:[0x60] and tests the BeingDebugged byte at PEB+0x2; if a debugger is attached WinMain returns 0 immediately without performing the injection

Import hiding / API obfuscation: all injection-related APIs are kept out of the IAT (only 12 benign KERNEL32 + 27 msvcrt imports) and resolved at runtime by a custom export-table walker (manual_get_proc)

decoded_strings.note: 32-byte blob g_encrypted_dll_path in .data (VA 0x140003000) decrypted in WinMain with repeating 8-byte XOR key 5a3c7fe12d94b86a (g_xor_key in .rdata at VA 0x140004000) via xor_decrypt(); result is null-terminated and passed to inject_dll as the LoadLibraryA path

encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded global byte array g_xor_key in .rdata at VA 0x140004000 (8 bytes, immediately followed by the plaintext "kernel32.dll" string). The 32-byte ciphertext g_encrypted_dll_path is a global in .data at VA 0x140003000. Decryption routine xor_decrypt() is at 0x140001480; called from WinMain with len=0x20, keylen=8.

injection_details.api_resolution: manual_get_proc (0x1400014ef) walks the in-memory kernel32.dll export table (checks MZ/PE signatures, reads export directory RVA at NT headers+0x88, iterates AddressOfNames/AddressOfNameOrdinals/AddressOfFunctions with strcmp) to resolve CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Process32First, Process32Next, OpenProcess, VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, CreateRemoteThread, CloseHandle, WaitForSingleObject and LoadLibraryA; module handle obtained via GetModuleHandleA("kernel32.dll")
injection_details.entry_flow: WinMain (0x140001ae9) first calls anti_debug_check(); if PEB.BeingDebugged is set it returns 0 without injecting. Otherwise it XOR-decrypts the 32-byte DLL path and calls inject_dll(path), then Sleep(1000) and exits
injection_details.execution: CreateRemoteThread(hProcess, NULL, 0, pLoadLibraryA, remote_path_buf, 0, NULL); then WaitForSingleObject(hThread, INFINITE) and CloseHandle(thread/process)
injection_details.open_process_access: OpenProcess(0x42A = PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD | PROCESS_VM_OPERATION | PROCESS_VM_WRITE | PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, explorer_pid)
injection_details.payload_write: VirtualAllocEx(hProcess, NULL, strlen(dllPath)+1, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE (0x3000), PAGE_READWRITE (0x4)) followed by WriteProcessMemory of the decrypted DLL path string (including NUL); LoadLibraryA address used as the remote thread start routine with the remote path buffer as parameter
injection_details.target_discovery: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS=2, 0), then Process32First/Process32Next loop calling strcmp(pe.szExeFile, "explorer.exe") to capture the PID (PROCESSENTRY32.szExeFile at +0x2C, th32ProcessID at +0x8); snapshot closed via CloseHandle
